text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The Tower of Luna, a place where clues to {0}'s memories lie. At its entrance, there was a woman staring blankly towards its summit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の失われた記憶のヒントが眠るルナの塔。
その入口で、呆然と塔を見上げる一人の人物がいた。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: So this is... the Tower of Luna? It's amazing how big it is up close...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが、
ルナの塔……？
近くで見るとこんなに大きいだなんて……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: And yet... I hadn't heard ANYTHING about this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたくし、
全っ然聞いてませんわよ！？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Ugh, geez... This kind of physical labor isn't really suited for someone such as me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう、
まったく……
このような肉体労働、
本来わたくしの仕事じゃありませんのに……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: If it weren't for Her Majesty's orders, I would've NEVER come to a place like this! I hope you really understand that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
陛下のご用命でなければ、
こんな場所絶対に来たりしませんわ！
そこのところ、
本当にわかっておられますの？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Well, as long as you understand, that's fine. As long as you do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
わかっていればいいんですのよ。
わかっていれば。

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Even though it was a situation where Her Majesty might have said she'd have wanted to investigate herself, wasn't it you who jumped onto the occasion to pitch in, Lady Creditta?
text_block_list.orig_text:
陛下自ら
調査に出向くと言いかねない状況だったとはいえ、
調査へ向かうと申し出たのは
クレジッタさま自身ではありませんでしたか？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: I hope you understand why I couldn't help it? There's no way I could let Her Majesty leave the capital when she's so busy. In the first place, it's just plain strange for a member of the royal family to go on some reckless adventure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方がないでしょう？
お忙しい陛下が王都を離れるわけにはいきませんもの。
そもそも、
王族が危険な冒険に出かけているのがおかしいのですけど……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Which is why, Her Majesty's loyal retainer... that is, I, CREDITTA CASH, is here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですからこうして！　
陛下の忠臣である
わたくしクレジッタ・キャッシュが出向いたのですわ！

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: So, you're here because the reconstruction work has settled down and there is no lucrative accounting work worth falsifying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
復興事業も落ち着いて、
改竄しがいのある美味しい帳簿仕事が
ないからですか？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Indeed... Wait! What are you trying to imply, Secretary No. 1?! I haven't done anything like that! ......Recently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう……
ではなくてっ！
何をおっしゃいますの秘書１号！
わたくしそんなことしていませんわよ！？　
………………
最近は。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: More importantly, in this circumstance! Her Majesty even went out of her way to tell me: “If you're up for it, then please take care of {0}-kun☆”!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回は特に！　
わざわざ陛下御自らわたくしに
『だったら、
{0}くんのことお願いしますね☆』
と仰せつかったのです！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: She placed an order on me anticipating my utmost loyalty; There's no way I could refuse it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このわたくしの忠義を見込んでのご用命、
断ることなどできませんわ！

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: I can't believe this is what someone who only intended to stop the "train" but ended up getting picked up and sent to investigate in her stead would say...
text_block_list.orig_text:
止めるだけのつもりだったのに
うっかり乗せられて
調査に出ることになった人間の言うこととは
思えませんね……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Well, that might've been my intention at first, but I can't let Her Majesty just look so disappointed, can I...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
まあ最初はそうでしたけど、
陛下にあんな残念そうな顔をさせてしまっては、
ねえ……？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: However, Her Majesty also said: "Since you're going through all this trouble, please enjoy the adventure in my stead☆" ...Is this really an adventure one such as me would be able to enjoy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし陛下からは
『せっかくですから、
わたしのかわりに冒険を楽しんできてください☆』
とも承ってますが……
本当に楽しめるレベルの冒険ですの？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Leaving the matter whether I'll be able to enjoy it or not aside. It's for Her Majesty's sake, so I'll do my best! FIGHT ON! CREDITTA!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
楽しめるかどうかはともかく。
陛下のためですもの。
頑張りますわよ！　
ファイト！　
クレジッタ～！

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Well, break a leg, I guess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
せいぜい頑張ってください。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey... why are you suddenly acting like it's someone else's problem?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとちょっと、
あなた何を他人事のように……

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Please wait just a second, Lady Creditta... Who are you talking to right now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってくださいクレジッタさま……
今、
どなたと話しているのですか？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: What are you saying, Secretary No. 1? I'm obviously saying that to y-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何を言ってますの秘書１号？
そんなのあなたに決まって……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: WHA-?! There's TWO Secretary No. 1? What does this mean?! No, wait... if there are two, then in this case one of them is No. 2...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！？　
秘書１号が二人？
どういうことですの！？
いえ……
二人いるということはこの場合どちらかが２号……？

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: No. 1 or No. 2... I wonder who has the higher salary...
text_block_list.orig_text:
１号と２号、
どちらが給料が高いのでしょう……

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Although it's always better to have more people... This isn't exactly the time to be messing around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人手が多いにこしたことはありませんが……
……などと、
ふざけている場合ではありませんね。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Wh-What the hell is going on here?! Don't tell me this is some monster from the Tower of Luna...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いったいどうなってますの！？
まさかルナの塔の魔物……

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... You're still wet behind the ears.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
まだまだ甘いですね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: {0}. You've probably seen me use my transformation magic once or twice before. You need to train your powers of observation more.
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴方は
私が変身魔法を使ったところを見たことがあるでしょう。
観察力をもっと鍛えなさい。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: SO IT'S YOU! You're that hip-pocketing magician who clings to Her Majesty's side every once in a while! What on EARTH would bring YOU here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた！
たまに陛下にくっついている腰巾着の魔法使いではありませんこと！
いったい何故にこんなところへ！？

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: HEY, I'M TALKING TO YOU! Don't ignore me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとちょっと！
わたくしを無視するんじゃありませんわよ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I'm here because I heard you were heading towards this tower, {0}. I decided to accompany you since there are a few things I wanted to check. You should be grateful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴方がこの塔へ向かうとのことでしたからね。
少し確かめておきたい件もあるので
同行することにしました。
感謝するのですよ。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Eh...? But I was the one who received Her Majesty's orders to come h-...! HAHHH! Don't tell me... you're here because you intend to snatch the credit away from me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい？
陛下の命を受けたのはわたくしのほうですのに……！
はっ！　
まさか、
手柄を横取りするつもりですの！？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: If your plan was merely to investigate this Tower, you could've just relied on me entirely. And yet... why are you with such an obviously shady woman?
text_block_list.orig_text:
塔の調査であれば
私を頼ればよいだけの話でしょうに。
なのに
なぜこのような胡乱な相手と一緒になど……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Honestly... You really lack a fundamental sense of danger. Listen carefully. First of all, you need to be aware of just what kind of precious existence you are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく……
貴方と言う人は
本当に危機感が足りませんね。
いいですか？　
まずは自分がどういう存在なのか自覚を……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Hold on right there! You're just a mere court magician, to think you'd go and call me suspicious of all people... That's quite a pompous thing to say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待ちなさい！　
たかが一介の魔法使い風情が
このわたくしをつかまえて胡乱とは……
ずいぶんと偉そうな物言いですわね！

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I do think it's true that you're shady.
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念ながら、
胡乱なことは事実かと。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Et tu, Secretary No. 1!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと！　
秘書１号！？

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Is something the problem, Creditta Cash? For someone still on probation, you're acting quite bossy all of a sudden.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにか問題があるのですか、
クレジッタ・キャッシュ。
試用期間だというのに
偉そうなのは貴方のほうでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Ugh, that and what you're saying are two different things! I'm already in charge of the practical aspects of this job as Her Majesty's loyal retainer, you know!? Me and my assistant are more than enough to help him investigate a Tower like th-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ、
それはあなたが勝手に言ってるだけですわ！
わたくしはすでに
陛下の忠臣として実務を任されてますのよ！？
こんな塔の調査くらいわたくしたちだけで十分……

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: That said, it's certainly true that our strength alone is quite worrying. With just the three of us, it's going to take quite some time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが、
確かに私たちだけでは戦力の不安がありますし。
無駄に時間もかかってしまうかと。

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't it be more efficient to have this magician accompany us, Lady Creditta?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こちらの魔法使いの方にも、
同行していただくほうが
効率的ではありませんか？
クレジッタさま。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Ugh... True enough, you may have a point there... However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
確かにそうかもしれませんけど……
けど……

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: I JUST DON'T LIKE WHO I DON'T LIKE!
text_block_list.orig_text: 気に入らないものは気に入りませんのよー！

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Such a defiant way of living...
text_block_list.orig_text: 開き直りましたね……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Well, that's fine. Putting those trivial matters aside... Since I'm here, I'll make sure this investigation is a success. First, let's have {0} share some information about his previous investigations.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいいでしょう。
つまらないことは置いておいて……
私が来たからには
この調査、
確実に成功させますよ。
まずは貴方から
前回の調査の情報を共有してもらいましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: No matter what I say, you'll still follow us, is that it...? Oh geez, why is this happening...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうあってもついてくる気ですのね……
ああもうまったくもう、
どうしてこんなことに……

text_block_list.name: Secretary
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on... let's stop acting like kids and get this investigation underway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら。
子どもみたいなことを言っていないで
調査を済ませてしまいましょう。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
なんでもありませんよ。

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Although things aren't going well and I'm being toyed with, I have received a direct order from Her Majesty. This CREDITTA CASH... will make sure to see this through to perfection and report back to her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
上手くいかないことばかりですけど、
陛下直々の命ですもの。
このクレジッタ・キャッシュ、
何としてもやり遂げてご覧にいれますわ！

text_block_list.name: Creditta
text_block_list.text: Please wait for my return!! Your Majesty EUSTIANAAAA!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待ちになっていてくださいまし！！
ユースティアナ陛下～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The curtain rose on the investigation regarding the Tower of Luna, along with Creditta’s resounding determination.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クレジッタの決意と共に
ルナの塔の調査は幕を開けるのであった。
